name: Tetrix by Deskree
description_en:
The current product on deskree.com is Tetrix, a knowledge layer that maps code, documents and infrastructure for AI-assisted software investigation. It indexes source material into entities and relationships, then exposes that context through research, MCP and programmatic interfaces. This replaces the old catalog’s generic collaboration description; it does not assert that former Deskree accounts or projects migrate to Tetrix.

Community Edition and Enterprise have different architectures and rights. Most importantly, the proprietary CE license permits one-person evaluation and prohibits production and team use, despite broader free/small-team wording on the pricing page. Local storage also does not imply that query context never reaches a configured external model provider.
description_zh:
deskree.com 当前展示的产品是 Tetrix：为 AI 辅助软件调查映射代码、文档及基础设施的知识层。它把源材料索引为实体和关系，再经研究、MCP 及程序接口提供上下文。本稿替代旧目录的通用协作介绍，不断言原 Deskree 账户或项目会迁移到 Tetrix。

Community Edition 与 Enterprise 的架构和权利不同。最关键的是，专有 CE 许可只允许单人评估，禁止生产和团队使用，尽管价格页的免费／小团队文字更宽泛。本地存储也不表示查询上下文绝不会到达所配置的外部模型服务。

sections.title_en: This Deskree entry now describes Tetrix
sections.title_zh: 本 Deskree 条目现描述 Tetrix
sections.en:
The current homepage and about page identify a system-knowledge product from Deskree. The core job is to assemble engineering context across code, services and infrastructure for questions about dependencies and impact. It is not supported by these sources as a generic chat, whiteboard or shared task-board service.

The original catalog identifier and discovery category are retained for coordination, but the old feature list is superseded. Existing-product migration, account continuity and compatibility with earlier Deskree development products were not established. Evaluate the current Tetrix edition and contract on their own terms.
sections.zh:
当前首页及公司页展示 Deskree 提供的系统知识产品，核心任务是汇集代码、服务及基础设施上下文，用于依赖和影响问题。所读来源不支持把它描述为通用聊天、白板或共享任务看板服务。

为便于协调，保留原目录标识及发现分类，但旧功能表已被替代。原产品迁移、账户连续性及与早期 Deskree 开发产品兼容性尚未确立，应按当前 Tetrix 版本及合同评估。

sections.title_en: Separate structural indexing from the answer it enables
sections.title_zh: 区分结构索引与它支持的答案
sections.en:
The technical overview describes code/doc ingestion, AST-derived structures, entity storage and incremental updates. Entities combine source text, metadata, embeddings and relationships; a reasoning model uses that mapped context to answer questions.

For a proposed endpoint-change investigation, start with a small repository and its relevant documentation. Ask which symbols depend on the endpoint and inspect the cited source paths and revisions. A parsed graph does not by itself prove runtime reachability or a performance effect; dynamic configuration, missing sources and stale ingestion can change the answer. No repository was connected and no accuracy or coverage benchmark was run.
sections.zh:
技术概览描述代码／文档导入、AST 提取结构、实体存储及增量更新。实体组合源文本、元数据、嵌入及关系，推理模型据这些映射上下文回答问题。

假设调查端点修改，可先用小型仓库及相关文档，询问哪些符号依赖该端点，再检查引用路径及版本。解析图本身不证明运行时可达性或性能影响，动态配置、缺失来源及过期导入都可能影响答案。未连接仓库，也未测试准确率或覆盖率。

sections.title_en: Free CE is an evaluation license, not free production software
sections.title_zh: 免费 CE 是评估许可，不是免费生产软件
sections.en:
The CE license explicitly restricts use to one permitted user for evaluation, excludes production and team use, and limits autonomous loops and external-system actions. Its evaluation term can end under the published conditions. It is proprietary; a public installer link would not change the software rights.

This conflicts with the pricing page’s small-team wording and some broad capability descriptions. Treat that as unresolved product/contract scope rather than silently granting the broader use. A team deployment or an unattended agent workflow needs the applicable commercial agreement. This research only reads public material and does not install or use CE.
sections.zh:
CE 许可明确限一名获许可用户评估，排除生产和团队使用，并限制自主循环及外部系统动作；评估期可按公开条件结束。它属于专有软件，即使存在公开安装器也不会改变软件权利。

这与价格页的小团队文字及部分宽泛能力描述冲突，应保留为未解决的产品／合同范围，不能默许更宽用途。团队部署或无人值守 Agent 流程需适用商务协议。本研究只读公开资料，没有安装或使用 CE。

sections.title_en: Local indexing still leaves a model-provider decision
sections.title_zh: 本地索引仍需决定模型服务数据流
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says CE uses Docker plus an OpenAI API key: indexing and storage are local, while query-time reasoning sends code context in OpenAI requests. The terms separately describe prompts and responses going directly to the chosen model/embedding provider and billing that provider account.

Therefore, a local container is not a guarantee of offline inference or zero external processing. Before evaluating proprietary code, identify the actual provider, permitted source scope and credential handling. Enterprise is described as a separate deployment in the customer’s cloud with model choice; its exact networking and retention behavior require the actual deployment configuration. No provider key was requested or configured.
sections.zh:
价格 FAQ 称 CE 需要 Docker 和 OpenAI API key：索引及存储在本地，查询推理时会在 OpenAI 请求中发送代码上下文。条款另行说明提示和响应直接流向所选模型／嵌入服务，费用计入该服务账户。

因此本地容器不保证离线推理或零外部处理。评估专有代码前，应明确真实服务商、允许来源范围及凭据处理。Enterprise 被描述为在客户云中独立部署并可选模型，其准确网络及保留行为需按实际配置核对。本研究没有请求或配置 provider key。

sections.title_en: A knowledge interface and an action workflow have different authority
sections.title_zh: 知识接口与动作流程具有不同权限范围
sections.en:
The overview presents Deep Research, MCP and API over the knowledge layer. Its read-only wording concerns the source-system behavior it advertises; it should not be expanded into an audited permission guarantee for every agent or connector. The CE license narrows advanced features and external actions, while Enterprise pricing advertises team collaboration and two-layer RBAC.

For a proposed shared investigation, specify the sources each user may see and whether an answer can expose information from a restricted source. Confirm both retrieval and generated-answer behavior. Source permissions, graph visibility, reasoning access and write-capable integrations should be demonstrated in the intended edition rather than inferred from a single marketing sentence.
sections.zh:
概览展示知识层上的 Deep Research、MCP 及 API。其只读文字针对所宣传的源系统行为，不能扩展为对每个 Agent 或连接器经过审计的权限保证。CE 许可收窄高级功能及外部动作，Enterprise 价格页则宣传团队协作及双层 RBAC。

假设做共享调查，应指定各用户可见来源，并核对答案是否可能披露受限来源信息，分别检查检索及生成答案。源权限、图可见性、推理访问及可写集成应在目标版本演示，不能从一句营销描述推定。

sections.title_en: Budget the license, provider usage and operated environment
sections.title_zh: 同时预算许可、模型用量及运行环境
sections.en:
The price page labels CE Free and Enterprise per-seat without a public amount. Enterprise terms put fees, billing, renewal and cancellation in the order form or master agreement, with no-refund as the default unless that agreement changes it. Cloud resources and model requests are separate cost considerations.

The FAQ’s CE installation repository returned Not Found through the GitHub connector for both the repository and main README lookup. That does not identify the reason or prove product closure, but it prevents verification of the advertised install path here. Hardware sizing, pinned images, upgrade/migration, backup/restore and failure retry were not established. Preserve original sources and check a recoverable index before depending on a local knowledge store; the vendor’s no-SLA CE terms do not supply recovery targets.
sections.zh:
价格页把 CE 标为 Free，Enterprise 按席位但未公开金额。Enterprise 条款把费用、账期、续订和取消交由订单或主协议规定，默认不退款，除非该协议另有规定。云资源及模型请求是另行考虑的成本。

FAQ 所列 CE 安装仓库及其 main README 经 GitHub 连接器查询均为 Not Found；这不能解释原因或证明停运，但使本次无法核实宣传的安装路径。硬件容量、固定镜像、升级／迁移、备份／恢复及失败重试未确立。依赖本地知识存储前应保留原始来源并核对可恢复索引，CE 无 SLA 条款不提供恢复目标。

sections.title_en: Evaluate engineering context, not automatic operational truth
sections.title_zh: 评估工程上下文，不当作自动运营真相
sections.en:
Tetrix is relevant to investigating relationships across engineering material when the selected edition can legally and technically access that material. A useful acceptance case names one known dependency, one intentionally missing source and one changed revision, then compares the explanation and citations against the source system.

The product’s deterministic-mapping language is not independent proof that every operational question is answered correctly. Nor do compliance labels establish a particular certification or approved sensitive-data deployment. Teams needing normal collaboration features, guaranteed rollback decisions or a freely redistributable backend should state those requirements explicitly. No alternative relationship, performance improvement or production readiness is certified by this draft.
sections.zh:
目标版本在法律及技术上能访问相关材料时，Tetrix 可用于调查工程资料间关系。一个有用验收例可明确已知依赖、故意缺失的来源及一个修改版本，再把解释和引用与源系统比较。

产品所称确定性映射不是每个运营问题都能正确回答的独立证明，合规标签也不确立具体认证或已获准敏感数据部署。需要普通协作功能、保证正确回滚决策或可自由再分发后端的团队，应明确提出这些要求。本草稿不认证替代关系、性能提升或生产就绪。
